pages.name: About
pages.seoTitle: About Wayfarer — an independent photo journal
pages.seoDescription: Who Wayfarer is and how it works — a small circle of photographers and writers who go slowly, sell prints, and take no sponsored trips.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Wayfarer is an independent travel and photography journal. We go slowly, on foot where we can, and we come back with pictures and the writing that earns them — the road it took to get there, the hour the light was worth waiting for, and the people we met along the way.
We work with a small circle of photographers and writers, and we sell prints of the work so the next expedition pays for itself. No sponsored trips, no press junkets — just the places, seen properly.

pages.name: Contact
pages.seoDescription: Get in touch with Wayfarer — questions, orders and anything else you need.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-8

children: A place we should photograph, a story we should chase, or a print you want in a size we do not list yet? Tell us. We read every message, and we answer the good ones from wherever we happen to be.
